subject: Novatech pilot — request to pause demo and join waitlist
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Novatech pilot — proposed architecture deep-dive (30–45m)

Hi Amit —

Great speaking with you earlier. Per our call, attaching a short agenda for the architecture deep-dive and a suggested two-slot window for a demo next week. High-level:

- 30–45 min technical demo focused on inference throughput/latency for your batch workloads
- Short Q&A for security/compliance (SOC2, data retention)
- Next steps: quick pilot scoping and timeline

Suggested times (PST):
- Tue 2027-06-22 10:00–10:45
- Wed 2027-06-23 14:00–14:45

If those don't work, tell me a couple slots that do and we will adapt. I've put the preliminary agenda in the attachment.

Attachments: novatech-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novatech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novatech pilot — proposed architecture deep-dive (30–45m)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for the agenda and the quick turnaround. I wanted to be upfront: leadership just reallocated our AI/ML sprint capacity to a cross-product analytics initiative through the end of Q3. Coupled with several folks (including our VP of Engineering) being on the road for the next three weeks, we need to deprioritize the LLM/inference pilot for now.

A few specifics:
- We are pausing new vendor pilots until September.
- Procurement is on a temporary freeze while we reconcile budget lines.
- We are happy to stay in touch, but please put the demo on hold and add Novatech to your waitlist for when we reopen pilots.

Could you do two things for us while we're paused?
1) Share a one-page summary we can drop on our roadmap doc (one-pager on expected latency/cost tradeoffs + minimal infra reqs).
2) Mark us as paused in whatever pipeline you use (we'll recontact once we have a confirmed slot).

Apologies — this is not a reflection on Redwood; it's internal timing. I'll ping you when the team is back and we can rebook.

Best,
Amit Rao
Head of Data Platforms | Novatech Analytics
amit.rao@novatech.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@novatech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Novatech pilot — proposed architecture deep-dive (30–45m)

Thanks for the transparency, Amit — I appreciate the heads-up. Totally understand the runway shift.

We'll do the following:
- Put Novatech on our internal waitlist and mark the deal as "on hold" (DEAL-7812).
- Share a one-page summary + a short scoped architecture note by EOW that you can drop into your roadmap.
- Remove proposed demo slots from calendars for now; when you re-open, we'll propose a small (20–30m) re-intro focused on the specific integration points you care about.

I'm attaching the agenda again and will follow up with the one-pager (PDF) and a 2-slide latency/cost summary. If it helps, we can also provide a 15-minute async recording of the runtime's performance profile for your infra team.

Quote: "leadership just reallocated our AI/ML sprint capacity to a cross-product analytics initiative" — noted. We'll set a 90-day reminder to check back unless you message sooner.

Attachments: novatech-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF)

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference\

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-28T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Novatech — outcome & next internal steps (paused)

Quick update for pipeline hygiene:

- Outcome: Novatech (DEAL-7812) has deprioritized LLM pilot due to an internal sprint reallocation and travel; prospect asked to pause demos and be waitlisted.
- External contact: Amit Rao (Head of Data Platforms). Contracts is on hold; procurement freeze in effect.

Action items:
1) Move DEAL-7812 to "On Hold" stage in HubSpot and add note referencing Amit's email. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/novatech-7812
2) Cancel any scheduled demo invites and release the reserved demo slot for the week of 2027-06-22.
3) Karthik: please prepare the 1-page latency/cost summary (2 slides + PDF) and upload to the drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-novatech-pilot
4) Monica: add a 90-day follow-up task and tag Amit as "re-engage Q4" in the CRM.

Notes: keep them on the waitlist but do not continue active outreach until they re-open. This is a soft hold — we should not remove them from the pipeline permanently.

Thanks — Jordan
